prompt: /hamburger-method Implement user authentication with SSO, MFA, social login (Google and GitHub), and session management for our SaaS application

assertions.text: Does NOT just split into separate stories — applies layered options to each authentication concern
Identifies functional authentication layers: identity verification, credential storage, session management, MFA, social providers
Generates at least 4 options per layer with explicit quality gradient
The smallest vertical slice is username/password only — SSO, MFA, and social login are explicitly deferred to follow-up slices
SSO integration is identified as a high-complexity option and deferred beyond the first 2 slices
The smallest slice is production-deployable and provides real value (users can actually log in), not just a prototype
Proposes at least 4 follow-up slices showing the incremental path from basic auth to full SSO+MFA
